capabilities.description: Customers can book tickets for skating sessions. Each request is checked and priced, then paid through PuckPay checkout. Payment results are applied without double-processing, and unpaid bookings are released when they expire. Business rule violations are reported as classified domain errors.
capabilities.name: Skating session booking and payment

capabilities.description: Members get a monthly allowance of free skates, and the business enforces this limit when they book.
capabilities.name: Member free-skate allowance

capabilities.description: Staff can schedule new rink sessions and see how many tickets are still available. Available capacity goes down when clubs book the rink: it halves if one half is taken and drops to zero if the whole rink is booked.
capabilities.name: Rink session scheduling and capacity management

capabilities.description: The business holds a fixed stock of hire skates for each shoe size. It works out how many skates of each size are free for a session and stops bookings when a size runs out.
capabilities.name: Skate hire stock and availability

capabilities.description: Staff can get sales and occupancy reports for a Monday-to-Sunday week or for any date range, such as a whole season, and export them as CSV.
capabilities.name: Sales and occupancy reporting
